title: Chapter 13: The Lord'S Invitation
content:
Chapter 13: The Lord'S Invitation

Wu Qing spent the whole night listening to Weiyi sing for him in different ways, unable to do anything else.

After a sleepless night, the sky breaks.

The whole world is finally quiet.

Wu Qing routinely dispatched puppies to disperse in the surrounding areas of the Zerg territory to act as scouts and informants.

When it got daylight, some puppies found the way to look for him.

"Sure enough, it's here."

Wu Qing smiled. He didn't want people to know the situation in the Zerg territory for the time being, so he rushed to the place agreed with Hu Tu yesterday.

It didn't take long for the two to meet.

"Brother Wu! You are indeed here!"

Hu Tu was very happy to see Wu Qing.

He is wearing a very exquisite set of half-body armor today, and his weapons are still short bows and daggers, but they are not ordinary at first glance. These are the result of the proliferation of biological clothing.

A person relies on clothes, a horse relies on a saddle, and after changing his equipment, Hu Tu, as a fox tribe member, has a completely different temperament. He is clean and handsome, with a sense of cleverness.

"You're so happy. What's the happy event?"

Wu Qing was in a good mood when he saw Hu Tu.

"What a good thing! Yesterday, I brought the news that my Zerg friends had destroyed the bugbear army back to the territory, and the lord sent someone to find me!"

"The lord said that he has something to discuss, and he wants to invite his elder brother and friends from the Zerg tribe to the territory to discuss it in detail!"

The status of a lord is the most noble in this world. Hu Tu had contact with the lord, and it could be seen that he felt very proud.

Wu Qing learned from the chat with Hu Tu that this kobold lord was a second-generation lord who did not seek advancement, but this was his own analysis through relevant information.

Hu Tu's description of the lord was very respectful.

"No problem, I just have something I want to talk to your lord about."

Wu Qing readily agreed.

It was his plan to contact the lords of this world through Hu Tu.

Of course, Wu Qing is not an inexperienced young man like Hu Tu. He has considered all risks.

This time Wu Qing will not go alone, but will lead an army of Zerg there.

Regarding his own safety issues, with the collective consciousness of the Zerg Queen, ordinary dangers can be faced calmly.

He generally does not consider irresistible dangers. Even if a person is sitting at home, there is still the possibility of disaster coming from the sky.

Just because there are risks, you don’t dare to do anything.

If he really encounters a life or death crisis, he still has a hidden system, and the system has never let him down.

Among the Zerg combat troops, except for leaving a small number to help guard the territory and dispersed outside to act as eyeliners, Wu Qing had to take the rest with him.

500 puppies and 100 hydralisks rushed over, and 10 huge hosts flew in the air.

All the Zerg troops walked out of the forest and came to the grassland of the plain.

Hu Tu was very excited to be in such close contact with the large Zerg army. He greeted the puppies and hydralisks around him from time to time, but these two combat units could not speak, and their mental strength was not strong, so they could not communicate with him.

"Brother Wu, are we going to bring the Zerg army there?"

Hu Tu had seen how powerful the Zerg were, and following the Zerg army gave him a sense of security.

"Yes, we need to let the lord see the strength of the Zerg, otherwise he will have to come here, which will be a waste of time."

Hu Tu felt that what Wu Qing said made sense.

In this way, Hu Tu led the way, and Wu Qing set off with the Zerg army.

After climbing a few hills, Wu Qing saw a miniature city built by the river.

The city's architecture is a fusion of Eastern and Western styles. The square-shaped city is protected by a low wall, and in the center of the city is a Western-style castle.

The two main streets are in the shape of a cross, running from southeast to northwest.

Outside the city, there are a large number of fields, which are lush and green at this time, and are planted with food and fruit trees.

This is the red soil territory where Hu Tu lives.

"Brother Wu, we're here!"

Hu Tu pointed in the direction of the city.

"I'll go back and report the news first, otherwise everyone will be frightened by the Zerg friends."

He said and ran away quickly.

"If it were Lao Cao who led the troops, he might have you arrested and beheaded. With your appearance like this, he thought you had led him into an encirclement."

Wu Qing complained helplessly.

He saw that many people working outside had begun to run towards the city. When they encountered the Zerg army for the first time, the pressure was really great.

There are several avenues outside the city that pass through the fields and lead directly to the city.

The Zerg army slowed down and walked slowly on the road.

Wu Qing wanted to leave some time for Hu Tu to negotiate with the Red Earth Territory first.

Because it was the active invitation from the Lord of the Red Earth Territory, relevant preparations had been made, but I didn't expect Wu Qing to bring a terrifying army.

Hu Tu brought the news back to the city, and the tense atmosphere in the entire city eased much.

When Wu Qing came to the city, he saw the gate of the city open. A group of kobolds surrounded a fat kobold in gorgeous clothes, welcoming the arrival of Wu Qing and the Zerg.

Wu Qing couldn't tell the age of the kobold, but he felt that the leading kobold Xiaopang was a very young kobold.

Hu Tu was standing aside, looking a little restrained here.

"Lord of the Red Earth Territory, welcome our human friends and all Zerg friends to visit us!"

The chubby kobold was indeed the lord himself. When he opened his mouth to welcome, his tone was a little stiff, as if he had rehearsed it.

His dog face is very similar to the Chinese rural dog in Wu Qing's impression. He looks very cute and friendly. His voice is a little shrill, giving people a feeling of babyish voice.

"Wu Qing meets the lord!"

Although Wu Qing has no knowledge of the expression of dog faces, he can see from the fact that the lord calls himself the lord and does not give his name that this dog-headed lord is very arrogant and does not take Wu Qing seriously.

Wu Qing gave his name and called the other party the lord.

After some awkward and polite chats, the dog-headed lord invited Wu Qing to enter the city.

Wu Qing only brought a small team of puppies and hydralisks into the city, and the other Zergs were stationed outside the city.

The lord took Wu Qing into the city, and the people in the city ran out, stood in the distance, and curiously observed the Zerg.

A group of strange alien races were pointing and talking about the hideous and terrifying alien insects, and the scene was surprisingly harmonious.

"Are these the Zerg that destroyed the followers of the evil god?"

"They look like they can fight. It would be great if the lord could form an alliance with the Zerg!"

"How much food do they have to eat every day with such a big body!"

"It's better to be a little bit miserable than to become a follower of the evil god and become a walking corpse!"

"The lord invited the Zerg here for the purpose of forming an alliance. Don't worry!"

"Speaking of which, I really envy the little guy from the fox tribe. He has established a relationship with the Zerg and will have a good life in the future!"

"Yes, I have to thank that little guy. If it weren't for him, we would have been lucky to have half of us alive today!"

"I heard that many people who were in a hurry to escape from the city yesterday encountered strange things, and many people even retreated!"

"..."
